name: the allowlist stops being forced to shrink
expect: a fixed token left in KNOWN_GAP fails

name: the allowlist may name tokens the shim no longer defines
expect: KNOWN_GAP naming a token the shim dropped fails

edits: raise ValueError("no `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { html { … } }` block found")
expect: missing shim block RAISES, never returns empty

name: a token merely mentioned counts as declared
expect: a token mentioned without a colon is not declared
